Voters are encouraged to reach out via direct messages or email to report misleading AI responses. This program aims to enhance the quality of election information that AI platforms provide to users.

title: US judge extends ban on tree removal at Trump's golf course after 430 cut
content: A US federal judge has extended restrictions on President Donald Trump's renovation plans for Washington's historic East Potomac Golf Course after at least 400 trees were cut down. The court has banned further tree removal and ordered advance notice before irreversible changes. Trump, however, plans to close the 106-year-old course on November 15 despite an ongoing legal challenge.

title: Melania Trump-brokered truce brings hope to starving Ukraine city of Oleshky

Ukrainian officials have expressed strong dedication to the truce, seeking to provide vital resources and aid for civilian evacuations. Many individuals, especially children, have endured dire conditions for years amidst the relentless fighting.

title: Flyers pay 120.5% more when booking day before departure; Bengaluru-Chennai fares rise
content: On the morning of 16 September 2026, fares across 54 domestic routes showed a stark divide in how much last-minute booking costs. On Ahmedabad to Pune, waiting until the day before departure meant paying 120.5 per cent more than a ticket bought 30 days ahead. On Bengaluru to Chennai, that same wait added just 2.9 per cent. The gap between the two extremes is wide enough to matter for anyone planning travel.

title: 118/0 in 36 balls! India script jaw-dropping record in 3rd T20I win over NZ
content: India crushed New Zealand in the third T20I, setting a world record with 118/0 in the powerplay while chasing 199. Abhishek Sharma smashed an unbeaten 57 off 20 balls, while Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored 44 off 17 deliveries. India also reached 100 in five overs and 50 in 2.2 overs, winning by six wickets to take a commanding 3-0 series lead.

title: San Francisco mansion once a theatre and reportedly a brothel lists for $25m
content: Verdier Mansion, nestled in the heart of San Francisco's Russian Hill, is currently listed for $25 million. Built in 1906, this storied property boasts a legacy of scandal, creativity, and mystery. Having changed hands multiple times, it saw significant renovations in 1992, restoring its classic charm. Offering six levels and panoramic city views, the mansion is a unique testament to the neighborhood's vibrant social evolution throughout the years.

title: Facebook co-founder Dustin Moskovitz says the ‘top job’ is not for him
content: Dustin Moskovitz co-founded Facebook and later started Asana, where he served as CEO for over a decade. Despite his achievements, he admitted that managing teams was not his true calling. Moskovitz faced increasing challenges during his tenure due to external social and political upheaval. Many corporate leaders, like Moskovitz, find themselves in management roles without formal training or desire. This phenomenon of the 'accidental manager' has become common in workplaces.

title: Children help prevent 6,821 cigarette butts from reaching sea at Ecuador beach
content: In Ecuador's coastal community, children spearheaded a two-year initiative to combat cigarette butt pollution. They collected thousands of butts, leading to a notable reduction along the beach. The project not only educated the youth but also empowered them to engage their families in clean-up campaigns. Local authorities actively supported these efforts, demonstrating the critical role of young voices in tackling environmental issues.

title: Kochi nursery fire may be terror plot rehearsal targeting Jews, police suspect
content: Police in Kochi are investigating whether a fire at a horticulture nursery near the Kadavumbhagam Synagogue was a test run for a wider plot. Messages recovered from the accused’s phone allegedly refer to Jewish places of worship and attacks in several cities. Investigators are tracing the senders, following cryptocurrency payments including USDT, and examining reconnaissance visuals and three suspected practice runs in Ernakulam rural. The anti-terror squad is involved, and an NIA handover is under consideration. Police say no organised terror network has yet been established.

title: Roman emperor's headless torso sells for $34.26m, up from $7.36m in 2010
content: A stunning marble torso of a Roman emperor made headlines at an auction, fetching an astounding $34.26 million, breaking previous records. This remarkable piece, which was sold for only $7.36 million in 2010, showcases its enduring appeal. With its origins in ancient Rome, the sculpture highlights military honor and divine connection, and it has been featured in significant museum displays across the US.

title: 13,800-year-old Alaska campsite reveals hearth and traces of ancient shelter
content: Archaeological research at Shég’ Xdaltth’í’ in Alaska revealed a rich site dating back 13,800 years. The site included stone tools, animal remains, and evidence of a possible shelter. Researchers identified activities such as food processing, toolmaking, and clothing production among early inhabitants. Comparisons with similar tools in Siberia suggest cultural connections across the Bering Land Bridge.

title: Dyslexic campaigner wins UK award for 25 years of helping vulnerable families
content: Andy Willis received the Community Shining Star Award at the Dyslexia Awards 2026 held in Telford. He has been a community campaigner for 25 years, supporting vulnerable individuals and families in Banburyshire. Known as the 'People’s Champion', he founded the Banburyshire Advice Centre to help residents navigate support systems. His extensive voluntary work has contributed to raising awareness of dyslexia and the support available.

title: Waited 3 months for silver Royal Enfield, got blue; dealer ordered to pay Rs 28,000
content: A Kerala consumer commission has taken a firm stand against a Royal Enfield dealer for unfair practices following a delayed motorcycle delivery. After an arduous wait of three months, the buyer received a different colored model, compounded by issues reported upon pickup. The ruling mandated the dealer to compensate the complainant with Rs 25,000 plus legal fees, with a strict 30-day timeline for compliance to avoid accruing additional interest.

title: Jordan strikes Syria after church attack, claims 20-plus Islamic State terrorists killed

Military reports indicate that over 20 militants were neutralized. While the Jordanian military aimed to minimize civilian harm, Syrian sources revealed that the strikes resulted in seven fatalities, including three children, illustrating the complex repercussions of this military engagement.

title: Who named Cyclone Arnab and why? Where it will hit, states on alert & preparedness

The India Meteorological Department has issued alerts for severe winds and torrential rainfall affecting multiple states. Emergency shelters and control rooms are set up as beach access is prohibited to ensure public safety. Heavy rains are also impacting Odisha and Jharkhand. Residents are urged to stay updated and minimize travel during the cyclone's effects.

title: PETA releases footage of newborn monkey tests in $4.2m Washington study
content: Peta has released disturbing footage revealing that infant macaques at the University of Washington are subjected to neurological tests. These experiments involve forcibly separating the babies from their mothers to study the effects of a neurotoxin. Most concerning is that many of these vulnerable infants were reportedly euthanized post-testing. Experts condemn this practice as unethical, highlighting its detrimental impact on the primates' development.

The protests were linked to plans to redevelop the Haslar Immigration Removal Centre to house migrants awaiting deportation. title: 'Apologise to nation': Rijiju slams Cong after Army debunks Chinese intrusion claims
content: the BJP accuses the Congress of circulating an AI-generated video . the video falsely attributed claims about Chinese control of areas in arunachal Pradesh to an Indian Army officer . BJP's union minister demands an apology for allegedly tarnishing the Army's image .

title: Reports of fraud attempts, missing ballots as Israel votes in crucial elections
content: the election is the country's first national vote since the attack that triggered the war in Gaza . more than 7.3 million Israelis are eligible to vote to elect members of the 120-seat Knesset . early turnout was strong, with 16.68% of eligible voters cast their ballots by 10 am local time .

title: New Rs 1,000 note with temple design? PIB Fact Check debunks viral claim
content: PIB Fact Check clarified that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has made no announcement regarding the issuance of a new Rs 1,000 banknote . a purported yellow-coloured note featuring a temple motif went viral on social media, with some posts claiming it had been issued .

title: $445 million and counting: Musk goes all in for Republicans ahead of US midterms
content: the republican party, its congressional super PACs and US president Donald Trump’s MAGA Inc. had raised $2.1 billion through October 14 compared with $1.4 billion raised by corresponding Democratic committees . Musk’s political spending has helped widen the Republican Party’s fundraising advantage ahead of the November midterm elections, projected to be the most expensive elections ever in the US .

title: Fireworks and celebrations as student-led movement wins in Serbia; can they deliver?
content: a key question remains: can a leaderless student movement, with little experience of governing, turn its electoral victory into lasting political change? the election follows nearly two years of student-led demonstrations sparked by the collapse of a canopy at the Novi Sad railway station in 2024 .

title: 'Propaganda against E20 was a paid campaign': Gadkari as govt paves way for E100 fuel
content: union road transport minister says critics have faded against petrol blended with 20% ethanol . he says the opposition to E20 has intensified about three months ago . the government notified changes to motor vehicle rules allowing flex-fuel vehicles to run on fuel containing up to 100% ethanol (e100)

title: UP CEO apologises for 'thank God Ram didn't hit any minority' post
content: Navdeep Rinwa apologises for his office's sarcastic reply to aam aadmi party MP . the UP CEO said the language and tone of the post were not in line with the nature of communication expected from the poll body . this comes a day after Sanjay Singh questioned Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over an erroneous vote entry .

title: Canadian woodworker spends years gathering 300 logs for off-grid forest cabin
content: woodworker cody Bokshowan is known as Trustin Timber, and documents woodworking, self-reliance and wilderness life . the project began eight years ago with the painstaking task of cutting down trees for its construction . he decided to do the work himse, directing massive trunks without ropes or pulleys .
